2511-7084-8338.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5034-5330-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5034-5330-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2103-2707-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
2103-2707-8267.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5670-7452.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Cauldron of Essence and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

573-2645-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Gruul Turf's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{G}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

3165-3532-5078-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5078-7902.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

2034-5086-5183-7743-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-7743-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

3129-4636-5770-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

225-751-765-3314.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-765-3314.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7060-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1879-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

331-3059-7408.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to Furnace of Rath.
331-3059-7408.notes: Malignus also makes the damage unpreventable due to its static effect. This combo should result in each opponent losing the game except in niche circumstances.

4367-7334.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
The Neutrinos is modified.
4367-7334.description:
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering it and Akki Battle Squad.
Resolve the Akki Battle Squad trigger, causing you to untap all modified creatures you control and to get an combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Neutrinos trigger, blinking Akki Battle Squad and causing it to enter tapped and attacking.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-2457-3000-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

57-4846-6657-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6657-7175.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7158.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

893-2921-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1414-2866-4986-6798.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3129-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Primal Vigor.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-2178-5256-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-2178-5256-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters plus one due to Kami of Whispered Hopes on Sin.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Kami of Whispered Hopes trigger.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Kami of Whispered Hopes trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

586-5626-6112-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-4753-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Clever Impersonator trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

2018-5330-5570.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-4210.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-4210.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3194-3582-3967.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

856-4321-5256-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5256-5477.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

618-1379-1558-2567.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
618-1379-1558-2567.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar with haste.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Avenger of Zendikar token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1063-1633-2060-2942-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

698-4050-4182-4258.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
698-4050-4182-4258.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {5}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {U} due to Will's ability.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return it to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {U}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-2172-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2172-5195.description:
Cast Burning Inquiry from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Burning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards and discard three cards at random.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

679-3966-4971.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-3966-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1475-4535-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-4535-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
The Spirit tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Good-Fortune Unicorn that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1763-4385-4587-4893.description:
All slivers have haste.
Tap a Sliver to generate {1}.
Use that mana to create a Sliver with Sliver Queen's ability.
Use the newly created Sliver to repeat the cycle.
